scope: Two actual offscreen D3D12 1280x720 arsenal frames; inspected final compact six-row comparison and bound-Tab exact-details view, upgrade preview, costs, cash, inventory, deltas, DPS, party/solo estimates and control labels. No hardware-input, animation, audio, frame-rate or normal-play acceptance.
findings: Cash and cost status readable at top without overlap
Summary separates current/selected columns and makes +50% damage, +9% rate and +7 rounds easy to scan
Accuracy/recoil use plain categories; chosen behavior has a short description
Exact details and enemy rows readable without clipping
Controls and model assumptions fit within both frames
Prototype presentation retained; player comprehension acceptance pending
